name: Azeroth Companion
title: Warcraft Research — Equipment & Talent Handoff
features: New Warcraft Equipment Research Board in Live Armory cross-references Blizzard-returned equipped item IDs against the player's manually saved Item Atlas records, Loot Hunter goals and assigned character targets.
Search, filter and incrementally review source-returned items by personal tracking status; responsive item cards show official item IDs and clearly distinguish manual labels from verified equipment.
Use INSPECT ITEM to open the existing official Item Codex, or TRACK GOAL to explicitly add an item to the existing Loot Hunter board when the player chooses.
Read-only Talent Forge handoff summarizes selected talent nodes and manually planned points without attributing those allocations to the active in-game character.
No added Blizzard API requests, authentication changes, data migrations or changes to the existing HYPER MUSIC and Founder identity layout. Real-player and iPhone testing remain pending.
